# Winifred Tolley

## Overview

- **Age:** In her late fifties in Volume 4 and near sixty in Volume 5.  <sub>[v4 c8 P47](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0047), [v5 c16 P49](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0049)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c5 P25](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0025), [v4 c6 P13](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c35 P0](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls  <sub>[v4 c6 P39](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0039)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farm manager  <sub>[v4 c6 P15](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0015), [v4 c16 P14](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0014)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mrs. Ambrose Kerr  <sub>[v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)</sub>; Mrs. Kerr  <sub>[v4 c10 P57](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0057)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Winifred  <sub>[v4 c6 P21](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

She is a stout, round-faced, rosy-cheeked woman with small, sharp, dark eyes, dark hair, and a energetic, cheerful countenance. She is unconcerned with fashion, dressing in practical, older-style clothes, such as a chocolate print wrapper adorned with large pink roses and a black straw hat fastened securely with an elastic band.

_Sources: [v2 c29 P10](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0010), [v2 c29 P18](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0018), [v4 c6 P20](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0020), [v4 c8 P15](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0015)_

## Personality

Miss Winifred is a candid, outspoken, and determined woman who prides herself on speaking her mind freely without fear or favor. She possesses an acerbic, sharp tongue and a deep-seated, humorous contempt for men, yet she also holds an exceptionally warm, compassionate, and generous heart, constantly helping neighbors in need. Firmly grounded in her Presbyterian faith, she possesses a fierce dislike for Methodists and a strong commitment to practical duty.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c8 P13](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0013), [v4 c8 P34](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0034), [v4 c8 P38](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0038)_

## Traits

- Outspoken and candid  <sub>[v2 c29 P10](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0010), [v4 c3 P9](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0009)</sub>
- Cynical toward men  <sub>[v4 c6 P23](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0023)</sub>
- Compassionate and charitable  <sub>[v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c8 P23](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0023)</sub>
- Fear of scarlet fever  <sub>[v3 c24 P0](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0000)</sub>
- Strictly Presbyterian  <sub>[v4 c8 P31](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0031), [v4 c8 P34](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0034)</sub>

## Abilities

- Expert needlework and sewing  <sub>[v2 c29 P25](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0025), [v4 c6 P21](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0021)</sub>
- Managing a household and farm  <sub>[v4 c6 P15](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0015), [v4 c16 P14](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0014)</sub>

## Goals

- To assist neighbours and look after the less fortunate in her community  <sub>[v4 c6 P23](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0023), [v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040)</sub>
- To maintain a well-kept, orderly home  <sub>[v4 c16 P13](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0013), [v4 c16 P14](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0014)</sub>

## History

Miss Winifred Tolley spent her whole life as a spinster residing at Seven Gulls. Known for her sharp-tongued independence and dislike of men, she nevertheless dedicated herself to acts of community charity, such as sewing clothes for needy children. When Nell Harcourt moved to Seven Gulls, Miss Winifred quickly became a close, supportive friend and frequent visitor to the house of dreams. Over time, she actively supported Lorna Vane, providing her with guidance and taking in a former orphan, Mary Stubbs, to live with her. In her late fifties, after years of declaring she would never marry, she surprised the community by accepting the marriage proposal of her long-time suitor, Ambrose Kerr, and moving him into her home.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P39](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0039), [v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c8 P23](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0023), [v4 c9 P38](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0038), [v4 c16 P15](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0015)_

## Background by volume

- Had a single brother who passed away fifteen years prior to her marriage  <sub>[v5 c2 P18](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0018), [v5 c2 P44](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0044)</sub>
- Spent her entire life residing on her own property in Seven Gulls  <sub>[v4 c6 P39](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0039), [v4 c16 P15](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0015)</sub>
- Remained unmarried for over fifty years despite numerous suitors  <sub>[v4 c16 P15](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0015)</sub>

## Quotes

> It is a mercy that women possess patience, believe ME!  <sub>[v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038)</sub>

> I will under no circumstances marry a man who lacks sense, and that is my final word.  <sub>[v4 c6 P21](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0021)</sub>

> Though I might be an old maid, you do not catch ME speaking ill of men. They suit me fine.  <sub>[v4 c22 P10](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0010)</sub>
